_comment: ENF-1. `families` are the model.schema.json $defs whose every property is a tracked keyword `<def>.<property>`.
A keyword is WITNESSED by a probe naming it in its own `keywords` array (NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max/behavior-probes/*.json);
this file never repeats that. A keyword with no probe must sit in an `allowlist` group with a reason and an open ledger id.
frozenCount pins the number of allowlisted keywords: it may only shrink, and lowering it is part of the same commit as the probe that removes an entry.
Checked by scripts/quality/check-dsl-behavior-witness.py (aiKnowledge gate); the probes run in scripts/quality/run-behavior-probes.ps1.

allowlist.reason: Structural container or identity key: a concept, flow, query or field cannot exist without it, so a runtime that ignored it would fail every probe at once; there is no separate behaviour to witness.

Identity, authoring or migration metadata (uid, metadata, renamedFrom, module, satelliteOf, specializes): consumed by tooling and the migrator, with no behaviour observable through the running app's REST API.
Presentation only (labels, help text, pickers, icons): rendered by the browser shell and covered by the browser scenarios, not by REST behaviour.

Declared on WidgetEnforcementDemo.state (Draft option) and accepted, but no runtime surface serves them: the enums metadata catalog carries label, order, group, default, deprecated, iconHint, badgeHint and description only. They reach the generated UI shell alone, so they need a browser scenario (or a catalog column), not a REST probe.

Validated against the concept's autoPanel workbench actions (LifecycleValidation) and applied by the browser workbench to show or hide action buttons; it has no REST-observable effect, and no fixture panel declares a workbench action for it to gate.

Need a DataSource: the create and scheduleEvent orchestration actions are built only when an entityManager / dataSource exists, and CrudOrchestrationSupport.toRuntimeOrchestration refuses the WHOLE rule when any action cannot be built (reported at SEVERE since REG-286, no longer silent). This InMemory fixture has neither, so the action cannot run and no evidence event exists. Needs the h2local variant (run-behavior-probes.ps1 -LiveFieldVariant) with a rule whose actions are create / scheduleEvent.

Declared by no query in the corpus (permissionRequirements, tracePolicy); add a fixture query that sets them first, then a probe that asserts a caller lacking the requirement is refused and the trace policy changes what is recorded.
Applies only to external-AI review packs, not to an ordinary concept read or write.

map: the mapped arguments are not echoed by any evidence event (OrchestrationCapabilityFailed carries orchestration, capability, operation and the source event only) and the webhook target is not served in the probe environment, so the delivered request cannot be inspected; needs a local HTTP listener started by the probe runner. action: actionMetadata, presentation only.

aggregate.onValidate: the fixture's ValidateWidgetOrderProcedure is a pass-through and no procedure step available to the fixture fails on demand, so the pre-write veto cannot be provoked. aggregateCollection.via: no collection declares it (referenced ownership is unexercised). concept.events: no concept declares events. flow.action / flowStep.action: actionMetadata (UI). flowStep.data: no flow step declares it.
